title: Review an employee expense-policy exception
source_note: Created policy-review probe patterned after the Federal Travel Regulation, the official source for federal travel and expense rules.
prompt:
Review this expense-policy excerpt and state the controls it imposes in at most 60 words:

Employees must attach an itemized receipt for expenses above $25. A manager must approve exceptions before reimbursement. Finance rejects duplicate claims and claims submitted more than 30 days after travel.

Mention the receipt requirement and approval requirement. Return only the review.

title: Extract filing facts into a structured record
source_note: Created extraction probe using the field-oriented JSON pattern exposed by the SEC companyfacts API.
prompt:
Extract the four named fields from this filing note. Return one JSON object and no commentary.

Filing note: Entity: Northstar Components Inc.; fiscal year: 2025; revenue: $48.2 million; operating income: $6.1 million.

Required JSON fields: entity, fiscal_year, revenue_usd_millions, operating_income_usd_millions.

title: Classify customer complaints for routing
source_note: Created triage probe patterned after the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database, which publishes real complaint categories and narratives.
prompt:
Route each complaint to exactly one queue: BILLING, FRAUD, or ACCESS. Return exactly one line per ticket as '<id>: <queue>'.

T1: I was charged twice for the same monthly fee.
T2: A transfer I do not recognize appeared yesterday.
T3: My password reset link always expires before it opens.

title: Retrieve a clause from a contract corpus
source_note: Created retrieval probe patterned after searching public agreements and exhibits in EDGAR.
prompt:
Find which document contains the termination-for-convenience clause and report its document ID and notice period in one sentence.

D1: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice.
D2: Either party may terminate for convenience with 60 days' written notice.
D3: Confidentiality survives for three years.
D4: New York law governs this agreement.

title: Reconcile an invoice against the accounts-payable ledger
source_note: Created reconciliation probe anchored to the U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data program's official financial-data workflows.
prompt:
Reconcile the invoice and ledger. Report the exact discrepancy and which record must be investigated in at most 40 words.

Invoice INV-1042: subtotal $1,000; tax $80; total $1,080.
AP ledger INV-1042: subtotal $1,000; tax $55; total $1,055.

title: Draft a past-due collections email
source_note: Created drafting probe anchored to the CFPB's official debt-collection compliance resources.
prompt: Draft a professional collections email of at most 80 words. Invoice INV-1042 for $1,080 is 45 days past due. Ask for payment status or a proposed payment date. Do not threaten legal action. Return only the email body.

title: Correct an inaccurate management metric
source_note: Created remediation probe grounded in the federal data-quality and standards resources published by Data.gov.
prompt:
Correct the statement and show the calculation in at most 45 words.

Incorrect statement: 'Revenue rose from $47.0 million to $50.0 million, an increase of 10%.'

title: Write validation checks for an award record
source_note: Created validation probe patterned after the official USAspending API and its federal-award records.
prompt:
Write exactly three numbered validation checks for this award record, one per line.

Award ID A-77; obligated amount $90,000; outlay $75,000; remaining balance $15,000; start 2025-01-01; end 2025-12-31.

Include an arithmetic tie-out, date-order check, and identifier-presence check.

title: Produce a management performance and risk note
source_note: Created reporting probe patterned after management analysis built from public SEC filing facts.
prompt:
Write a management note of at most 90 words covering revenue performance, margin, and one risk.

Q2 revenue was $52.0m versus $50.0m last year. Gross margin fell from 42% to 38%. One supplier provides 65% of a critical component.

title: Review, extract, and validate a filing note
source_note: Created audit-preparation workflow combining common operations supported by official SEC filings and XBRL facts.
prompt:
Complete this audit-preparation task in three labeled lines: REVIEW, EXTRACT, CHECK.

Filing note: Northstar Components reports 2025 revenue of $48.2m and operating income of $6.1m; the prior-year values were $45.0m and $5.8m.

REVIEW: state what the note covers. EXTRACT: give 2025 revenue and operating income. CHECK: give one arithmetic or period-comparison check.

title: Classify a complaint and draft a response
source_note: Created support workflow combining complaint routing and response drafting against the CFPB complaint taxonomy pattern.
prompt:
Return two labeled lines, CLASSIFICATION and RESPONSE.

Complaint C9: 'I was charged the same $29 subscription fee twice this month.'

Classify as BILLING, FRAUD, or ACCESS. Draft a response under 45 words that acknowledges the duplicate charge and says it will be reviewed.

title: Reconcile, remediate, and report a close exception
source_note: Created month-end close workflow combining reconciliation, correction, and reporting using official financial-data and quality guidance as anchors.
prompt:
Return three labeled lines: RECONCILE, CORRECT, REPORT.

Ledger: cash $200, receivables $300, total current assets $500. Draft report says cash $200, receivables $330, total current assets $530 and claims receivables are 10% above the ledger.

Identify the discrepancy, correct the report values, and give a one-sentence close note.
